page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the weak category, with single-threaded gzip compression performing in the poor category. However, multi-core operations leverage the 32 dedicated cores effectively, yielding average results across stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression tests. Memory bandwidth, database operations, and Redis SET operations also consistently perform in the average tier.

The primary tradeoff of this instance is its lower single-threaded processing speed, which limits its efficiency for single-core tasks. However, its balanced resource density and dedicated CPU allocation make it suitable for multi-threaded workloads. Appropriate applications include static web serving, software compilation, database operations, and medium-scale LLM inference, where multi-core scaling can offset the single-core performance limitations.
